```yaml
name: Merge Queue Cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch merge queue entries
        id: fetch
        run: |
          echo "Fetching merge queue entries..."
          curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json; preview=merges+queue" \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/merges/queue" > queue.json
          echo "Fetched queue.json"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Remove UNMERGEABLE entries
        run: |
          entries=$(jq -c '.entries' queue.json)
          if [ "$entries" = "[]" ]; then
            echo "No entries in merge queue."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Processing entries..."
          echo "$entries" | jq -c '.[]' | while read -r entry; do
            status=$(echo "$entry" | jq -r '.status')
            if [ "$status" != "UNMERGEABLE" ]; then
              continue
            fi
            entry_id=$(echo "$entry" | jq -r '.id')
            pr_number=$(echo "$entry" | jq -r '.pull_request.number')
            echo "Removing entry $entry_id for PR #$pr_number"

            # Remove the entry from the merge queue
            curl -s -X DELETE \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json; preview=merges+queue" \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/merges/queue?entry_id=$entry_id"

            # Post a comment on the PR
            comment=$(jq -n --arg body "This PR was removed from the merge queue because it was UNMERGEABLE. Please rebase and re-open the PR." '{body: $body}')
            curl -s -X POST \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -d "$comment" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/$pr_number/comments"
          done
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
